|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Use 1 Force at the beginning of your battle phase to allow any two Imperials at an interior site to battle any one opponent's character (your choice); opponent suffers no battle damage here. No other battles may occur at this site this turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Local Trouble (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “At the beginning of your battle phase, use 1 Force to initiate a battle between two Imperials and an opponent’s character present at same interior site. For remainder of turn, no other battles may occur here and opponent takes no battle damage here.” '''What changed:''' “Use 1 Force at” → “At”; “phase” → “phase, use 1 Force”; “allow any” → “initiate a battle between”; added “and an opponent’s character present”; “an” → “same”; “site to battle any one opponent's character (your choice);” → “site. For remainder of turn, no other battles may occur here and”; “suffers” → “takes”; removed “No other battles may occur at this site this turn.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 41.
